retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Number distinguishes overlapping same-kind objects in part document order, with element-specific exceptions.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Start and stop identify musical endpoints rather than XML traversal order.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Musical ordering of same-kind span elements on one note is recommended rather than mandatory.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Continue identifies an intermediate span point without changing the musical meaning of start and stop.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Musical ordering of start-stop-single elements is recommended and single requires no pair.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: String numbering starts with the highest full-length string rather than the bottom staff line.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Tenths use global scaling and are unaffected by staff-size changes.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Absent text direction has a specified left-to-right interpretation.

retained_context_dispositions.closure: Document explicit-value precedence and the bidi override modes. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Let-ring denotes a sustained untamped sound using one visual tie endpoint.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: A visual tie on one note is recommended as start then stop, with let-ring and navigation exceptions.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Retain same-note encoding advice with its let-ring and repeat or coda exceptions. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Missing fermata type and empty fermata shape have explicit graphical defaults.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Unspecified text vertical alignment is intentionally chosen by the application.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: A mid-measure key cancellation should treat before-barline as left, and an absent location means left.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Separate the recommended mid-measure interpretation from the unconditional absent-location default during review. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Print-object is preferred to deprecated sign=none, which remains permitted.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Numeric fret rendering is the defined default while letters remain available.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Staff lines count upward from the bottom and positions outside the staff are permitted.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Staff numbers identify staves top to bottom within a part.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: An alternate staff is another view of the preceding staff rather than additional playback material.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: An unspecified staff type represents an ordinary staff.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Absent time-separator uses vertically arranged numerator and denominator.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: An unspecified time-symbol uses normal notation without changing meter values.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Whitespace-only ending numbers express an existing ending whose number is unknown.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Missing winged specifies an unwinged repeat barline.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Kind none explicitly removes harmonic meaning from accompanying root information.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: An empty root text is recommended to suppress printing for kind none, but the source names an absent numeral-step element.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Unqualified minor has natural-minor meaning rather than an application-selected minor scale.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Change, continue, discontinue, and resume carry line-pedal semantics without proving a sound defect when no line is drawn.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Extracted parts should show a system number once even when the score associates it with two positions.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Extracted parts should render a system mark once and system none limits it to the current part.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Octave-shift direction describes written display relative to stored true pitch.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: An octave-shift changes displayed pitch relative to note pitch; an upper 8va marking corresponds to down.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not transpose the sounding pitch a second time when applying display shifts. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Distance type is an extensible string rather than the list of examples.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Application-defined distance types remain representable alongside known appearance types.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Prevent a closed enumeration from being inferred from the examples. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Glyph type permits application extensions beyond the documented examples.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Line-width type permits application-specific values.

retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not introduce a closed enumeration over the schema string. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Grace-cue, grace, and cue appearance categories depend on both note branch and cue-size status.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: SMuFL note-name noteheads are better represented with notehead-text than other plus smufl.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: MusicXML octave 4 begins at middle C.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Alteration values are semitone quantities and may be fractional for microtones.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Implicit yes is preferred for hiding a measure number while empty measure text is independently schema-invalid.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep the export recommendation separate from the existing nonempty measure-text lexical contract. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Absent bend-sound attributes have fixed playback defaults.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Bezier x coordinates replace deprecated offset coordinates instead of adding to them.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Dash and space lengths have no effect unless the line is dashed.

retained_context_dispositions.closure: Represent inactive attributes without treating their presence as invalid. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Explicit horizontal positioning can override directive placement.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Default-x, justify, or halign overrides directive-based horizontal placement; otherwise the anchor is the time signature or first notational item.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Specify how the contextual anchor is selected when the time signature or first notational item is absent. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Absent score version is interpreted as 1.0 rather than the validator's target version.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: The score's effective declared version is 1.0 when version is absent.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep export-version advice and the chosen validation profile separate from the absent-value interpretation. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: An unspecified font is a text font selected by the application.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: The default font is application-dependent unknown in the text-font category.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not require a particular font or substitute a music font by default. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Halign can inherit justify, but the fallback depends on whether justify is applicable.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Absent halign uses applicable justify; when justify is unavailable the alignment is application-dependent unknown.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Specify behavior when justify is applicable but also unspecified; do not invent a universal justify default. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Explicit justify supplies both block and line alignment when halign is absent.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: An explicit justify value sets horizontal block and line alignment unless halign explicitly separates the block alignment.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not generalize this conditional rule into a universal absent-justify default. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Letter spacing defaults to normal and numeric spacing is measured in em.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective letter-spacing is normal when absent; explicit numeric values are signed em quantities.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve negative tracking as meaningful rather than invalid. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Unspecified editorial parentheses, bracket, and size are application choices.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Each missing editorial-display parentheses, bracket, or size value is application-dependent unknown.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Resolve explicit attributes individually without forcing application choices into document requirements. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Normal is the default line-height while its concrete magnitude is application-dependent.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective line-height is normal when absent, with unresolved application-selected magnitude.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep the suggested 100-to-120 range advisory and avoid a numeric default. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Default coordinates establish origins while relative coordinates offset contextual defaults.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Default-x and default-y determine contextual origins; relative-x and relative-y offset the resolved default position, and credits use the page's lower-left origin.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Enumerate the documented measure and part-name origin exceptions before claiming complete coordinate semantics. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: More precise default coordinates are preferred when both positioning mechanisms are supported.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Retain renderer guidance while interpreting relative offsets with placement, offset, and directive context. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Print-object has an explicit yes fallback.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective print-object is yes when absent for objects supporting that attribute.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep dependent print-dot, print-lyric, and print-leger defaults in their separate conditional providers. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Print-spacing only controls layout when the note, dots, and lyrics are all hidden.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective print-spacing defaults to yes and is active only when note, dot, and lyric rendering are all suppressed.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Compute all three effective visibility values before determining spacing activity. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Missing print-dot and print-lyric follow note visibility while explicit values remain independent.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Absent print-dot and print-lyric resolve to no when print-object=no and to yes otherwise.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Apply explicit attribute values before the conditional visibility fallback. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Text rotation has a defined direction and pivot.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Positive text rotation is clockwise and negative rotation counterclockwise around the alignment point.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Use the resolved text alignment point as the rotation origin. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Playback defaults differ between ordinary trills and mordent variants.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: General trill-sound defaults are start-note=upper, trill-step=whole, two-note-turn=none, accelerate=no, beats=4, second-beat=25, last-beat=75; mordents use main, 3, 12, and 24 for the corresponding overrides.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Verify exact attribute correspondence and mordent override scope against the pinned source before closing this compound provider. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Image proportions should be preserved with one dimension and independently scaled when both dimensions are supplied.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Retain the scaling recommendation and leave required source and MIME type validation to their schema contracts. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: New-system and new-page positions should agree between parts, with undefined results on disagreement.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Report disagreement only as an optional interoperability advisory, not a universal structural error. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Page labels apply only to explicit new pages and staff-layout supersedes old staff-spacing.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Page-number and blank-page are inactive unless new-page=yes; staff-layout overrides deprecated staff-spacing.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Resolve new-page before field activity and retain layout-over-spacing precedence. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Link attachment depends on following sibling traversal and optional descendant selection.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: With neither element nor position, a link targets the next sibling; element selects within the next non-link, non-bookmark element and position is one-based only when element is supplied.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Specify descendant name matching and missing-target behavior before closing the attachment resolver. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Aligned partwise measures should use consistent labels but labels need not be numeric or unique.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not turn cross-part label consistency into numeric-only or within-part uniqueness requirements. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Implicit measures suppress printed numbering even when explicit text is present.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective implicit defaults to no; implicit=yes suppresses both number and text rendering for that measure.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep conventional pickup number zero separate from required suppression semantics. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Non-controlling measures need not share a left boundary with measures in other parts.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective non-controlling defaults to no; yes marks a part-local boundary that is not a cross-part controlling boundary.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Allow polymetric boundaries without requiring uniform measure alignment. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: A coda symbol benefits from matching playback information when playback is intended.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Scope the recommendation to playback reliability and preserve notation-only documents without sound markup. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Dynamics placement depends on whether it belongs to a direction or a note.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Within direction, direction placement overrides dynamics placement; on a note, the dynamics element's own placement applies.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Resolve the parent context before choosing the effective placement. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: A horizontal turn is unslashed by default.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective horizontal-turn slash is no when absent; yes adds a vertical stroke.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Restrict the fallback to horizontal turn forms supporting slash. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Empty fermata content denotes the normal shape and missing type means upright.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Empty fermata shape resolves to normal and missing fermata type resolves to upright.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Share the default provider with fermata-upright instead of duplicating independent obligations. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Fingering substitution and alternate default to no and fingering differs from pluck.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective fingering substitution and alternate are no when absent; on plucked instruments fingering identifies the stopping finger and pluck the plucking finger.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Separate the two defaults from the instrument-specific fingering interpretation. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Fret zero denotes an open string and fret one the first fret.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Fret numbering starts with the open string at zero and the first stopped fret at one.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Leave numeric domain validation to the schema and retain the open-string semantic distinction. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Reference editorial content is visual only and has explicit default reference and span type.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Level reference=yes has no playback effect; missing reference is no and missing type is single.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Apply the defaults without treating visual editorial content as a sounding instruction. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: MusicXML MIDI-unpitched numbering is one-based unlike common MIDI note numbers.

retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep conversion separate from the MusicXML lexical range check. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Pan and elevation use listener-relative angular coordinates.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Pan 0 is front, -90 left, +90 right, and ±180 rear; elevation 0 is level, +90 above, and -90 below.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Name-display display-text has local enclosure and language defaults.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Within name-display, display-text defaults to enclosure=none and language=it.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Resolve the local language default without rewriting the user's text. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Play instructions have note-local or continuing scope according to their parent.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Play in note affects only that note; play in sound affects later notes in musical order.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve the instrument-id recommendation separately from the parent-dependent scope. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: A segno symbol benefits from matching playback information when playback is required.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep this as playback guidance and accept notation-only use without sound. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: A barline wavy-line is recommended to use continue.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Retain should-level guidance without prohibiting other schema-permitted types. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Mid-measure attribute changes apply by musical position and staff scope.
