retained_context_dispositions.produces: When summed measure widths disagree with system width, effective rendering is application-dependent unknown.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve the discrepancy as unresolved layout behavior rather than unconditional document invalidity. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: One system-layout copy in the first visible part is sufficient.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Print/system-layout in the first visible part supplies the system context without required copies in other parts.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Identify visible-part order before selecting the authoritative system layout source. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Signed system margins modify page margins in opposite directions.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Negative system margins reduce the page margin and positive system margins increase the inset.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve signed values and do not impose universal nonnegative margins. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Relative links in compressed MusicXML resolve from the archive root.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: The base for a relative link inside MXL is the ZIP root, not the directory of the containing score entry.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep archive traversal defenses as separate security policy rather than changing this URI base. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Accidental editorial and cautionary flags default to no and do not define pitch alteration.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective accidental editorial and cautionary are no when absent; the printed accidental remains separate from pitch alter.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve explicit pitch data independently of accidental display flags. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: An ornament accidental is positioned from its ornament rather than the note.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: The layout origin for accidental-mark within ornament is the ornament's position.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not apply the ornament-origin rule to accidental-mark in other parents. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: An arpeggio without direction runs upward and number distinguishes related marks.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective arpeggio direction is low-to-high when absent; number associates coordinated or separate arpeggiation marks.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not require the optional unbroken cross-staff rendering hint. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: An arrow glyph should agree with the arrow's structural description.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Retain advisory glyph consistency and distinguish an arrowhead from a complete shafted arrow. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Assessment is recommended for ordinary notes and skipped for cue notes by default.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep assessment choice advisory while preserving absent player and time-only as all-player and all-pass scope. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Positive backup duration is described as recommended but is already mandatory in the schema.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Link the positive-divisions schema predicate and avoid a duplicate prose-level mandatory finding. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Backup is recommended not to cross a measure boundary or divisions change.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep boundary guidance advisory and do not derive meter-fill equality from it. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Beam number is a beam level rather than a unique group identifier.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Beam identity uses voice and grace or cue context, while number selects the level and up to eight levels serve 1024th notes.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Resolve the older beam-level wording conflict and define grouping across same-voice note sequences. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Fan behavior belongs to beam starts and certain continuations rather than every beam endpoint.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Beam fan defaults to none and is applicable at begin or a direction-changing continue; repeater=yes must be explicit on each beam using it.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Specify direction-change recognition and retain the legacy repeater clause separately from fan activity. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: A note that bends and then releases is encoded with two ordered bend elements, which is stronger than a display default.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Decompose the bend-then-release condition, two-bend cardinality, and order predicate; distinguish pre-bend and negative bend values before authorizing any failure. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Explicit elision text takes precedence over a glyph name and otherwise display can remain application-defined.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Nonempty elision text overrides smufl; if neither supplies a symbol, effective display is application-dependent unknown.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve text-over-glyph precedence without requiring smufl for textual elision. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Figured-bass prefix supports style-specific symbols beyond the listed examples.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Figured-bass prefix remains an open string domain with examples rather than a closed accidental enumeration.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not create an enum from the plus and accidental examples. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Figure-number expresses a number but its accepted numeric lexical grammar is not specified.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Decide the exact numeric predicate and treatment of textual variants before defining a regex; preserve suffix as the crossing mechanism. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Figured-bass suffix is extensible and can specify a stroke crossing the figure.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Suffix remains an open style-dependent string domain; slash, back-slash, and vertical can cross the displayed number.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep crossing behavior for known values without restricting extension values. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Figured bass anchors to a subsequent ordinary note and can change within its duration.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: The anchor is the first following nongrace, nonchord note in score order; figures are ordered top to bottom and parentheses defaults to no.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Resolve no-anchor cases and multiple in-note duration segments before closing attachment semantics. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Positive forward duration is already mandatory through the schema even though this prose is advisory.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Reuse the positive-divisions schema predicate rather than duplicating it as a prose error. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Forward is recommended not to cross measure boundaries or divisions changes.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep boundary advice distinct from an unsupported requirement to fill every voice to a full measure. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Glissando and slide have different line and pitch-continuity defaults.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Glissando defaults to a wavy line and distinct intermediate sounds; slide defaults to solid and continuous pitch movement.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep graphical line style and musical continuity as separate derived properties. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Grace timing uses neighboring-note percentages or added divisions instead of ordinary duration.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Steal-time-previous and steal-time-following are percentages of the respective neighboring note; make-time adds time in divisions.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Resolve the relevant neighbors and do not synthesize ordinary duration from its allowed absence. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: An empty hammer-on or pull-off leaves the printed designation to the application.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Missing textual content yields application-dependent unknown marking, while each hammer-on or pull-off span connects its own two notes.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep these local pairs distinct from any encompassing longer slur. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Organ heel and toe substitution flags default to no.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective heel and toe substitution is no when absent.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not derive a required numerical fingering from heel or toe notation. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: A hole is circular by default and location applies to half-closed states.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective hole shape is circle when hole-shape is absent; location is active for half-closed holes.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Separate shape fallback from the state-dependent location field. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Notes in a multi-instrument part are recommended to identify their instrument.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve MusicXML 4.0 support for multiple instrument elements rather than enforcing an obsolete single-instrument limit. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Same-type listen children on a note should differ in player or repeat-pass scope.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Limit the advisory to the containing note and evaluate target-scope overlap. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Consecutive text nodes can share one syllable, while a new syllabic requires a preceding elision.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Two lyric text elements without elision belong to the same syllable.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Split the same-syllable fact from the elision-before-new-syllabic predicate and reconcile sequence or cardinality overlap with XSD. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Lyrics have local alignment defaults and their own visibility overrides note-level suppression.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Lyric defaults are center, below, and baseline; halign follows justify, and explicit lyric print-object overrides note print-lyric.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Resolve each lyric's explicit fields before local defaults and parent visibility. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Mordent variants are short by default.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective mordent and inverted-mordent long is no when absent.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep MusicXML names distinct from differently named SMuFL mordent variants. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Non-arpeggiate marks the upper and lower ends of a bracket rather than every chord tone.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Non-arpeggiate endpoints identify the top and bottom notes of its graphical bracket and carry no independent playback change.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Determine whether endpoint-placement checks form a justified predicate and define partial or cross-staff chord scope. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Ledger printing follows note visibility by default and is irrelevant to rests.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Absent print-leger is yes unless print-object=no, when it is no; print-leger is inactive for rests.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve explicit inactive rest attributes without reporting an automatic error. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Attack and release adjustments are discouraged at incompatible sound-tie endpoints.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep tie-start release and tie-stop attack advice optional and retain independent divisions-based timing adjustments. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Cue elements determine silence independently of graphical cue size.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: A note containing cue is silent; cue-sized notation without a cue element remains eligible to sound.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep branch-based silence independent from effective note-size defaults. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Dot placement is inactive for notes in staff spaces and dot notation does not force intended duration equality.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Dot placement is ignored when the note sits between staff lines; dot count supplies notated augmentation only.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Resolve effective staff position without converting dot count into mandatory duration equality. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Default graphical note size follows grace and cue branch combination.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective type size is full for ordinary notes, grace-cue for combined grace and cue, and cue for grace-only or cue-only notes.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Reconcile category naming with note-size-category while keeping actual duration separate. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Closed notehead fill depends on note type unless explicitly overridden.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Closed noteheads default to unfilled for half notes and longer and filled for shorter types; parentheses defaults to no.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Enumerate applicable closed shapes and let explicit filled override the duration-based display fallback. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: A bend release offset does not change the timing basis of the bend's percentage fields.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Release offset is relative to the current note, while bend first-beat and last-beat remain relative to that note's original position.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Retain the original note origin when applying a release offset. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Measure rest identifies a complete measure rest without forcing a whole-note graphic or fixed duration.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Rest measure=yes represents a whole-measure rest in its actual measure context.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Support pickup and senza-misura contexts without requiring type=whole or a standard duration. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: The usual paired slur description is scoped background and does not mandate every visual slur be closed.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Retain this as anti-overconstraint background; do not use it as a required context provider or universal span-balance predicate. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: A relative stem adjustment that would reverse the stem is ignored.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective stem relative-y is inactive if it would flip direction instead of shorten the stem; a stem on a rest is a stemlet.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Define the default-y and relative-y bases and the flip threshold before evaluating activity. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Tap text overrides hand and an unspecified symbol remains an application choice.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Nonempty tap text takes precedence over hand; absence of both yields application-dependent unknown display.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve empty tap as a permitted representation without invented text. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Stopped has a specified default SMuFL glyph.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective stopped smufl is brassMuteClosed when absent.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Apply explicit smufl overrides without substituting merely similar-looking glyphs. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Open has a specified default SMuFL glyph.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective open smufl is brassMuteOpen when absent.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve the explicit-glyph override for related graphical symbols. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Half-muted has a specified default SMuFL glyph.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective half-muted smufl is brassMuteHalfClosed when absent.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep the default name distinct from other mute-symbol variants. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Literal lyric hyphens are recommended only for words that are themselves hyphenated.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Recommend syllabic for ordinary syllable division without rejecting every literal hyphen. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Sound ties and visual ties are separate constructs with potentially different scope.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Tie controls sound and can be limited by time-only passes; tied controls visual notation.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not infer one-to-one endpoint equivalence between tie and tied. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Equal or enharmonically equal pitch is recommended for ordinary visual ties.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve navigation and let-ring exceptions instead of banning all nonequivalent or one-ended visual ties. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Tied uses an implied number without the generic explicit default of one.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: A missing tied number remains an implicit identity distinct from explicit number=1.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Define how implicit identities match across overlap while preserving the explicit-versus-implicit distinction. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Time-modification describes the combined sounding ratio while tuplet notation describes visible structure.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Time-modification is the cumulative sounding relation from tuplets and double-note tremolo relative to note type and dots.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not require written and intended durations to coincide or infer full nested layout from this ratio alone. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: A normal note type different from the current note is represented by normal-type and normal-dot.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: An omitted normal-type can use the current note type only when the normal type does not differ.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Separate normal-type difference detection, required representation, and normal-dot interpretation; define what evidence establishes an otherwise unstated intended difference. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Zero strokes are recommended for unmeasured tremolo although the schema permits zero through eight.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep zero as advisory rather than narrowing the schema's accepted stroke counts. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Half-duration notes and a two-to-one ratio are recommended for double-note tremolo.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Multiply existing tuplet ratios when applying the advice and exclude single and unmeasured tremolo. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Tremolo glyph selection only applies to unmeasured tremolo.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Tremolo type defaults to single; smufl is active only for unmeasured and defaults there to buzzRoll.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep stroke count separate from beam count and treat other-type smufl as inactive. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Tuplet display has fixed line and label defaults but application-selected brackets.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Tuplet defaults are line-shape=straight, show-number=actual, show-type=none, and application-dependent unknown bracket; number identifies nesting rather than the ratio numerator.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Separate nesting identity from rhythmic ratio and preserve the unknown bracket choice. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Missing tuplet-actual display fields derive from sounding time-modification data.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Each absent tuplet-actual field falls back to its corresponding time-modification value when available.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Specify field correspondences and unresolved behavior when the relevant time-modification value is absent. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Missing tuplet-normal display fields derive from sounding time-modification data.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Each absent tuplet-normal field falls back to its corresponding time-modification value when available.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Specify normal type and dot fallback correspondence without treating optional source fields as required. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Unpitched notes without display coordinates occupy the middle staff line by default.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Absent display-step and display-octave on unpitched yield the middle staff-line display position without assigning a sounding pitch.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Define middle positioning for nonstandard line counts while preserving unpitched sound semantics. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Unpitched notation is recommended under an effective percussion clef.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Resolve the clef in musical order and retain should-level advice rather than a pitch-branch ban. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Credits use physical page numbers and sequential nonpositional formatting inheritance.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Credit page defaults to physical page one regardless of printed page-number; credit words and symbols inherit nonpositional formatting and default enclosure to none.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Enumerate inherited fields and reset boundaries while keeping physical pages distinct from printed labels. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Omitted score defaults generally leave rendering choices to the application.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Absent score defaults yield application-dependent unknown layout, scaling, and fonts, except for separately specified concert-score semantics.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve the concert-score exception and never turn unspecified layout defaults into file defects. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Part groups have no group symbol by default.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective group-symbol is none when absent.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep this group fallback distinct from the brace default for one multi-staff part. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Part-group starts and stops delimit score-part membership and carry positional obligations.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Group number identifies overlapping or nested groups; children of a stop are ignored.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Decompose start-before-first-part and stop-after-last-part predicates, membership derivation, overlap identity, and ignored stop children without requiring a group for one multi-staff part. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Group name-display formatting supersedes older group-name formatting.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Group-name-display formatting takes precedence over group-name formatting when both are present.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Retain valid legacy formatting when no replacement display is supplied. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Group abbreviation-display formatting supersedes older abbreviation formatting.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Group-abbreviation-display formatting takes precedence over group-abbreviation formatting when present.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not invalidate the legacy abbreviation form solely because it is deprecated. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Part links within a shared MXL resolve from the ZIP root to a part document.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: A relative part-link href in a shared archive uses the ZIP root as base and identifies a linked part document.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Separate base resolution from linked-document existence and target-kind decisions. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: A group-link is recommended to agree with the group content of its target document.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Leave the advisory outcome unknown when the target document cannot be read. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: The part-list determines top-to-bottom score part order.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Score-part sequence in part-list defines vertical part ordering.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep the schema's minimum-one-score-part check separate from display ordering. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Staff assignments use the containing part's top-to-bottom numbering.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: A staff reference addresses the corresponding numbered staff within the containing part.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not require explicit staff references throughout single-staff music. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Empty ensemble content explicitly represents unknown ensemble size.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: An empty ensemble has unknown size rather than zero members.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve unknown as a distinct state without imposing a positive-size repair. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Voice identifies a temporal event sequence within a part.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Events with a voice belong to a part-local linear musical-time sequence whose identifier is not restricted to numeric labels.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not infer a fixed voice enumeration or full-measure length requirement. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Clef line locates G, F, or C from the bottom and may lie outside staff lines.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Clef line is a bottom-up staff-position coordinate and is not limited to one through staff-lines.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep its positional necessity for applicable clefs separate from unsupported line-count bounds. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: The current meter supplies slash beat notation when explicit slash type and dots are absent.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Absent slash-type and slash-dot derive the repeated beat from the effective time signature when it exists.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Define compound-meter beat derivation and return unresolved context when no time signature exists. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Except-voice adds normal note display without suppressing slash notation.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Voices named by except-voice retain ordinary notation in addition to the displayed slashes.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not interpret except-voice as a part-wide slash cancellation. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Octave-change is additive and is not already included in diatonic or chromatic values.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Transposition separately adds diatonic or chromatic displacement and octave-change to written pitch.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Share the additive provider with transpose-additive to avoid applying the octave twice. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Octave-change is recommended for octave-sized or larger transposition intervals.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep the interval-size preference advisory and preserve the schema's integer range. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Duration controls the score cursor separately from visual notation and playback offsets.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Backup subtracts duration, forward adds it, and nonchord notes advance musical position by duration; chord notes do not advance that cursor.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Respect grace branch absence of duration and keep attack or release out of cursor arithmetic. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Intended duration may legitimately differ from the value suggested by type, dots, and tuplets.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Duration is intended timing data independent of computed notated duration.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not create an equality predicate without a separately authorized validation profile. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Display coordinates place rests and unpitched notes without defining sounding pitch.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Display-step and display-octave determine rest or unpitched staff placement; a percussion clef uses the treble reference G4 on line two.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Resolve effective clef by musical time and avoid assigning pitch to unpitched content. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Chord notes share a preceding base note's position, but incomplete anchor cases need explicit decisions.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: A chord note uses the position of the first preceding note without chord as its base anchor.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Decide missing anchors, grace or cue compatibility, and voice scope without inventing unsupported membership rules. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Color values use sRGB with defined alpha interpretation.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: RGB implies alpha FF; ARGB explicitly supplies alpha with 00 transparent and FF opaque, and RGB channels are sRGB.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep this interpretation separate from schema length and hexadecimal lexical checks. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Font-family supplies a comma-separated set of font names and distinguishes musical generic families.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Font-family entries form a comma-separated font selection list; music, engraved, and handwritten identify musical-font categories.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Verify selection-order semantics against the pinned source and preserve extensible family names. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Kind other describes harmony through added degrees without authorizing pitch-analysis rejection.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Kind other uses added degree entries as its harmonic description.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Decide whether any degree-completeness predicate is justified; do not require analysis agreement with sounding notes. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Normal-dot belongs to the normal tuplet type rather than the current note.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Normal-dot augments the normal-type side of the tuplet ratio, independently of the current note's type and dot values.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep both dotted-type quantities distinct when interpreting the ratio. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: UTF-8 archive entry names are recommended for interoperability.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep older name encodings admissible unless an explicitly chosen compatibility profile says otherwise. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: The container describes DEFLATE for ordinary entries while mimetype is an exception.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Ordinary MXL file entries are described with DEFLATE compression, excluding the special mimetype entry.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Decide whether the description establishes a mandatory compression predicate or permits compatible alternate ZIP methods. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: A first mimetype entry with the MusicXML MIME string is recommended, including version-sensitive omission cases.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Retain the exact ASCII media string and entry-order advice without making should-level presence mandatory. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: File extensions and MIME types are recommended format identifiers rather than proof of document validity.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Recommend .mxl and application/vnd.recordare.musicxml for archives, .musicxml and application/vnd.recordare.musicxml+xml for XML, and legacy .xml reader support. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Rootfile full-path is relative to the ZIP root.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: A rootfile full-path resolves from the archive root to an archive entry.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep required-attribute checking in XSD and entry existence in the separate archive resolver contract. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: A rootfile without media-type is interpreted as MusicXML.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Missing rootfile media-type means MusicXML; additional rootfiles may identify alternate representations.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Specify first-root selection and alternate representation handling without rejecting unspecified media-type. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Opus nesting has no normative fixed depth limit.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Opus may contain recursively nested opus documents and opus-link targets without a stated maximum nesting depth.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep resource limits and cycle protection as defensive processing policy rather than unsupported format constraints. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: An opus with no version is interpreted as version 1.0.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective opus version is 1.0 when the attribute is absent.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep the recommendation to emit version for 2.0 and later separate from the selected 4.0 validation profile. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Opus-link identifies another opus document, which can support a target-kind predicate after resolution.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: The expected linked target kind for opus-link is opus.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Formalize expected-versus-resolved target kind and unknown-on-unavailable outcomes; confirm source force before enabling document failure. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Score within opus identifies a separate musical score rather than an arbitrary resource.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: The expected linked target kind for an opus score reference is a musical score document.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Define accepted score roots and resolved target-kind comparison; unavailable external content must remain unknown. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Absent opus score pagination is application-dependent while explicit yes and no have defined meaning.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Missing score new-page yields application-dependent unknown; yes starts a new page and no continues the previous page.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve differences between applications instead of requiring common pagination. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: The sounds dictionary supplies standard identifiers without proving a closed instrument-sound vocabulary.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: The pinned sounds.xml supplies recognized standard MusicXML 4.0 sound identifiers.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Decide extension handling explicitly and do not derive a closed enum from an xs:string field. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Primary on sound selects a MusicXML identifier in the reverse library mapping.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: When several MusicXML IDs map to one library ID, sound primary selects the MusicXML ID for reverse mapping.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep reverse selection distinct from primary on any, solo, and ensemble children. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Any maps without solo or ensemble distinction and primary selects a forward library target.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: An any entry supplies a library ID for a MusicXML ID without ensemble discrimination; its primary flag guides MusicXML-to-library selection.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve multiple alternative mappings rather than imposing universal uniqueness. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Ensemble number describes group size while primary selects a forward mapping.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: An ensemble entry records ensemble size and uses primary for MusicXML-to-library target preference.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not impose exactly one primary=yes without an independently sourced cardinality rule. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Solo carries an application library identifier with a forward preference flag.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: A solo entry maps a MusicXML ID to a solo library ID, with primary selecting preferred forward mapping.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve multiple alternatives and distinguish forward from reverse primary semantics. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Reserved xml attributes retain their external XML meanings where the MusicXML schema permits them.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Xml base, id, lang, and space use their XML-defined semantics, including inheritance for base, lang, and space.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Complete the external normative XML contracts without treating xml.xsd import as permission for arbitrary attributes everywhere. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: An empty xml:lang explicitly clears an inherited language.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective language becomes unspecified when xml:lang is explicitly empty, overriding inherited language.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve empty-string reset behavior alongside local MusicXML language defaults. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: A note ending and beginning sound ties should list stop before start.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep this local ordering advice separate from permissible stop-before-start XML order across notes. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: One initial divisions value per part is recommended for broad interoperability.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Continue accepting legal divisions changes within the part and measure. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: The format defines no default tempo even though it defines a forte velocity reference.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Missing tempo remains unspecified; the normative forte velocity reference is 90.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not turn an application's fallback tempo into a MusicXML document requirement. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Tablature retains rhythmic data even when the rhythm is not printed.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Hidden tablature rhythm continues to use the ordinary note branch's timing semantics.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Decompose required branch-specific rhythm data and schema overlap, retaining the grace-duration exception instead of universally requiring duration. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: MusicXML 4.0 does not require type-specific archive directories for linked media.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Images, parts, and related archive resources may occupy arbitrary permitted ZIP paths rather than fixed media folders.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep directory organization advice separate from path resolution and security policy. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: JAXB and code-generation workarounds concern tooling rather than the standard MusicXML instance contract.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Exclude generated-name and XML-catalog workaround behavior from validation requirements without authorizing XML element renaming. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Deprecation preserves accepted forms except where the schema explicitly removed a form.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: DTD, function, and clef sign none are deprecated in 4.0; empty multiple-rest is removed and covered by the schema.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Separate deprecated-but-allowed content from the schema prohibition of empty multiple-rest. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: XLink actuate describes recommended traversal behavior rather than permission to access the network.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Retain onRequest, onLoad, other, and none guidance while requiring separate authorization and security policy for external retrieval. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: XLink show recommends a display context while other and none leave it open.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Retain new, replace, and embed presentation guidance and the attribute-group replace default without fabricating universal other or none behavior. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Accidental-text has a local Italian-language default.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective accidental-text language defaults to it when xml:lang is absent in the element's applicable language context.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Resolve interaction with inherited xml:lang rather than replacing every unspecified language globally. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: An empty breath-mark leaves the actual symbol to the application.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Empty breath-mark yields application-dependent unknown graphical symbol.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve the schema-permitted empty value and do not replace it with a fixed glyph. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Empty caesura has a defined normal shape.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Empty caesura resolves to normal.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep this fixed fallback distinct from the application-selected empty breath-mark. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: CSS keyword size ratios are scaling guidance rather than exact required renderer output.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Retain approximate ratios as advice without enforcing a mandatory pixel or physical size. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Supports value is meaningful only when attribute identifies what value describes.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Supports value is active only when the same supports entry supplies attribute.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Represent inactive value without an unsupported unconditional validity failure. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Encoder support declarations determine how absence of exported content can be interpreted.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Supports type=yes makes absence of the selected feature informative; type=no means the encoder does not support the feature and its absence proves no musical absence.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Resolve element, attribute, and value selectors before drawing absence-based conclusions. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Strong-accent points upward unless explicitly reversed.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective strong-accent type is up when absent.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Apply down only as an explicit change in the sign's peak direction. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: An absent octave-shift size denotes one octave without closing the permitted integer domain.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective octave-shift size is eight when absent; fifteen represents two octaves and twenty-two three.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Do not restrict size to the three examples and reconcile interval interpretation with octave-shift-size. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: An unnumbered measure-style covers all staves of its part.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective measure-style scope is all staves in the part unless number selects a single staff.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Apply staff selection without extending the scope to other parts. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Part-name-display formatting supersedes the older part-name formatting.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Part-name-display formatting overrides part-name formatting where supplied.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Retain schema-valid legacy attributes and clarify per-field override scope. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Part-abbreviation-display formatting supersedes the older abbreviation formatting.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Part-abbreviation-display formatting overrides part-abbreviation formatting where supplied.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve the older allowed form when no new display is present. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Slash notation should have start and stop unless it continues to the part end.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Preserve stop as the first beat without slash while keeping endpoint completeness advisory. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: The no-type extend start interpretation is explicitly historical.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: For versions before 3.0, extend without type denotes the start of lyric extension.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep the pre-3.0 fact scoped and decide modern omitted-type semantics separately instead of inventing a universal default. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Unspecified kind text and symbol choices belong to the application.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Missing kind text and use-symbols yield application-dependent unknown display choices; when use-symbols=yes, text follows the symbol.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Resolve explicit fields independently and keep symbol-plus-text composition conditional. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Accidental-text uses no enclosure by default across display contexts.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective accidental-text enclosure is none when absent, including notehead-text display use.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Apply the default locally rather than to every enclosing display object. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Display-text uses no enclosure by default.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Effective display-text enclosure is none when absent in names and other display contexts.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Reconcile this general local fallback with the name-display provider without duplicate obligations. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Lyric font defaults select lyrics by name and number, with unresolved overlapping-selector precedence.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: A lyric-font default targets lyrics matching its name and number selectors.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Decide conflicts among partial or overlapping selectors before assigning a unique effective font. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Lyric-language applies to matching lyric identity rather than matching verse text.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: A lyric-language default targets lyrics by lyric name and number and provides their default language.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Define partial selector matching and interaction with local or inherited xml:lang before closing the language provider. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Staff-tuning line numbers count upward from the bottom rather than by string pitch.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Staff-tuning line one is the bottom staff line.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep bottom-up line numbering distinct from highest-full-length-string numbering. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: A direction-type child's print suggestions apply locally rather than to the entire direction.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Print-suggestion values on a direction-type child affect that individual direction-type scope only.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Prevent local overrides from leaking into independent sibling directions. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Trill beats count played sounds rather than visual marks.
retained_context_dispositions.produces: Trill beats includes the first individual sound and excludes a closing two-note-turn.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Keep the counted playback events separate from graphical tremolo strokes or ornament marks. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_context_dispositions.rationale: Application-specific sounds.xml library mappings are outside score-instance validity.
retained_context_dispositions.closure: Exclude a universal virtual-library mapping requirement while preserving the separately scoped standard identifier context. English translation and semantic review remain pending; this is a planning disposition, not an executable contract.

retained_source_contracts.title: Source-only versus assessed decode
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Expose actual source-only and same-stream mapping APIs; InspectXML must not instantiate a model.

retained_source_contracts.title: Explicit target/profile preflight
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Validate nil context/reader/options, empty/unknown/incompatible profile and target before any read; snapshot options; nil assessment is sole permissive discriminator.

retained_source_contracts.title: No accidental production profile
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Any source API execution profile must name exact claim/support/roots; preserve all unavailable selected requirements rather than selecting only successes.
retained_source_contracts.later_boundary: Batch5 selects and tests all29 candidates and first bounded production profile; a bounded infrastructure source profile is not that release claim.

retained_source_contracts.title: Reader ownership and exactly one parse
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: One nonseekable original reader/parser for observation and conversion; no Close/Seek/replay/Encode validation or second XML parse.

retained_source_contracts.title: Observer below all loss
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Observe all unfiltered attributes/expanded elements/text below foreign/unknown skips and Attr in-place filtering.

retained_source_contracts.title: Exactly-once namespace expansion
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Never feed already expanded names to another expanding Token layer as if namespace URIs were raw prefixes.

retained_source_contracts.title: Mandatory namespace validity
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Close undeclared element/attribute prefixes and reserved namespace-prefix constraints under recorded XML/Namespaces versions, including skipped branches; no trust in encoding/xml acceptance.

retained_source_contracts.title: Duplicate attributes and provenance
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Retain lexical declaration flags separately from expanded names; detect duplicate lexical and expanded attributes before filtering.

retained_source_contracts.title: Prolog, tail and root
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Preserve optional declaration and legal DOCTYPE; enforce placement, one root, balanced names and EOF/tail grammar in all modes.

retained_source_contracts.title: XML edition, names and unsupported features
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Record exact supported XML/Namespaces edition and syntax boundaries; prove or explicitly classify underlying parser gaps. Pinned XSD datatype-name tables do not prove markup-name conformance.
retained_source_contracts.later_boundary: Batch9 owns complete transitive normative audit; batch4 still owns accuracy of source syntax claims it makes.

retained_source_contracts.title: Encoding and normalization
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Preserve selected UTF-8/UTF-16/Latin1 decoding, XML newline/reference normalization and immutable lexical views; XML normalization is distinct from XSD whiteSpace facets.

retained_source_contracts.title: Original-byte location provenance
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Only claim original-byte offsets with a proven mapping; otherwise label transcoded coordinates or omit position. Token-end InputPos is not start position.

retained_source_contracts.title: Copied token/namespace evidence
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Copy retained attributes, text and namespace snapshots before transient buffer reuse, including after filters/decoder reads.

retained_source_contracts.title: Exact declarations and type binding
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Bind assembly, parent, exact local/global declaration, anonymous owner and group-reference occurrence; resolved actual type differs from declaration. Missing binding is not name-wildcard matching.

retained_source_contracts.title: Shared grammar and invalid-tree recovery
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Reuse exact sequence/choice/repetition matching; independently visible descendants/violations survive where safely bound. Incomplete enumeration cannot prove missing required children/ID targets.

retained_source_contracts.title: Exact source scalar and cache identity
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Reuse root exact scalar/facet/canonical semantics once per stable source/domain/union-member/whitespace view; expose canonical atomic values only with proven type evidence.

retained_source_contracts.title: Actual type and nil
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Reuse QName scope, derivation/block/final/abstract, cvc-elt fallback, actual attrs/content, declaration nillability/default/fixed. Resolve source facts before model filtering.

retained_source_contracts.title: Datatype-only schema hints
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: User choice is fixed: schemaLocation list(anyURI), noNamespace anyURI; no pair-cardinality rejection and no fetch/schema selection.
retained_source_contracts.later_boundary: Batch8 discovery pairing retained separately; do not ask user to decide this again.

retained_source_contracts.title: Physical presence and effective defaults
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Do not rewrite source/model to implement defaults; preserve source occurrence identity and distinguish absent physical attribute, effective default, nil, empty text and canonical constraint value.
retained_source_contracts.later_boundary: Absent optional default/fixed ID participation and arbitrary constructed identity stay batch9.

retained_source_contracts.title: XSD identity entries and containing owners
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Do not substitute generic string-key ID plans for XSD1.0 declaration-eligible entry/actual-ID binding distinction; owners are source nodes, not paths or musical scope.

retained_source_contracts.title: Metadata discovery and replay provenance
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Preserve PR31 new-cause discovery versus cached replay epochs and genuine-invalid plus incomplete composition; no duplicate causes or false comparisons.

retained_source_contracts.title: Schema capability boundaries
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Retain opaque anyType/wildcard identity limitations, processContents skip versus unsupported lax/strict, general schema/UPA and unknown equality facts explicitly.
retained_source_contracts.later_boundary: Batch9 broader primitive/default/list/union/DTD and general normative closure unless explicitly reviewed earlier.

retained_source_contracts.title: Recoverable mid-element mapping failure
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Source observer owns its own stack independently of generated decoder position. Disable mapper, discard candidate and drain same healthy parser from exact position.

retained_source_contracts.title: Fatal drain stop and joined causes
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Recoverable mapping failure differs from fatal XML/I/O/session/budget/cancel failure. Stop feeding terminal session, Finish exactly once, join distinct mapping/source causes.

retained_source_contracts.title: EOF and completion truth
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Root closure alone is insufficient. SyntaxWellFormed/InputComplete require valid tail and actual EOF; missing nodes/IDs only after complete enumeration.

retained_source_contracts.title: No rejected document escapes
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Strict Decode returns Document only if nil operation error, Report.Satisfied and converted. Inspect violations live in report with nil op error; strict violated/incomplete returns error.

retained_source_contracts.title: New source error policy
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Record exact typed source/strict/representability/configuration errors and legacy aliases. Pure conversion or unknown-only strict outcome must not match ErrInvalidDocument.

retained_source_contracts.title: Finite account constructed before parsing
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Use one account for byte reader/parser/adapter/core/private binding; no hidden fresh account, resets/widening or duplicate core charges.

retained_source_contracts.title: Raw bytes and EOF probe
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Bound original raw bytes before buffering; define one-byte limit probe/read-ahead accounting honestly; Reader may return data plus error.

retained_source_contracts.title: Token growth before allocation
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Post-Token accounting alone cannot bound encoding/xml token allocation. Provide bounded lexical/token growth or honest aggregate input bound with explicit limits before token allocations.

retained_source_contracts.title: Raw work versus emitted events
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Declare raw token and namespace declaration/attribute attempts as distinct work from admitted core events; charge even discarded tokens and avoid same-resource duplicate wrapper charges.

retained_source_contracts.title: Depth and private live retention
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Tighter resolved Decode/assessment depth wins; charge private scalar/binding/namespace/candidate/fact retained payload and release owned live gauges once.

retained_source_contracts.title: Root XSD real work/cancellation
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Existing root helper work is not charged by mere core reuse. Instrument actual grammar/scalar/index/metadata paths with checked work and cancellation without abandoning polynomial evidence.

retained_source_contracts.title: Diagnostics are bounded outcomes
retained_source_contracts.batch4_obligation: Route new source/binder/conversion diagnostics through bounded accumulation; success/NA never consume diagnostic quotas; preserve exact counts/blockers and reserved terminal summary.

retained_source_contracts.title: Reader cancellation limitations
